scenarios.name: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited

scenario_steps.name: the user edits Sketch1 in the part, activates the drawing and collapses its drawing resources branch
the user selects the part document tab
the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the user selects the drawing document tab
the drawing sheet and drawing browser are displayed
the drawing resources branch is collapsed
the part remains available as an open tab
the user selects the part document tab again
the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the sketch editing environment remains active
